featured_reviews.name: Raghav Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a busy lawyer based in Toronto, my vacations are usually packed with family and city hopping. This time, while visiting Delhi and Mumbai, my sister—who’s lived in Mumbai for four years—gently pushed me far outside my comfort zone.
She had found deep transformation through yoga at Sacred Space Yoga, and I could see it in her calm, clarity and energy.

When she suggested the Shiv Yatra retreat led by Acharya Shiv and Harsh Pandey Sir, I hesitated—recent weight gain and zero flexibility made it intimidating. But I trusted her. And what followed was nothing short of magical.

From the first step into the Prabhadevi centre, a wave of peace washed over me. Among 15 strangers, there was instant connection—no judgment, just shared intent. Harsh Sir’s warmth and reverence for his brother set the tone, and when Shiv Sir entered, everything aligned: strength, grounding, humility, and authenticity. They truly walk the talk.

Over 24 hours, I experienced things I never had before—sattvik meals eaten in mindful silence, real meditation where the mind finally slowed, teachings that beautifully connected yoga to our cultural roots, and deep conversations with strangers who felt like family. A walk through Lions Park, herbal tea that somehow tasted divine, sleeping in a tent (never thought I would), and yoga that wasn’t about perfection—but about showing up honestly. That realisation alone changed something fundamental in me.
The sound healing session was especially profound—vibrations that shook loose buried emotions and old traumas, allowing release, lightness, and renewal.

What elevated everything was the genuine care—from the Pandey family, the way Shiv Sir and Harsh Sir ensured everyone’s comfort and safe return, and how they made us feel truly looked after. It wasn’t a retreat; it was family.

Shiv Yatra wasn’t just an experience—it was a divine wake-up call. I arrived skeptical and left transformed. Five stars aren’t enough. Infinite gratitude. Highly recommended for anyone seeking peace, regardless of age, body, or background.

featured_reviews.name: Aanchal Mittal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sacred Space is truly the best place for yoga and meditation. Shiv Sir and Harsh Sir are the OGs — they have a good knowledge of yoga but also have the rare quality of genuinely loving what they do. And it shows in every class.
This is not like a regular yoga class; it’s a complete experience, something you would usually plan and pay for on a weekend retreat.

featured_reviews.name: Anusha Tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text:
What unfolded over those precious hours was far beyond a retreat, it was a profound inner awakening. From the very first step into Sacred Space Yoga, there was a sense of calm, safety, and belonging that’s hard to put into words. Shiv Sir and Harsh Sir don’t merely teach yoga; they embody it with rare authenticity, humility, and grace.

Their presence, guidance, and values created an environment where transformation felt natural and deeply personal.

One of the most touching aspects for me was the sense of family they cultivated through their warmth, care, and attention to every single participant. Whether it was the mindful sattvik meals, the soulful meditations, the sound healing session, or the simple yet powerful conversations, everything felt intentional and deeply rooted in spirituality and awareness.

The kirtan session deserves special mention, it was pure magic. The collective chanting, rhythm, and devotion dissolved all barriers of mind. In that moment, there was only sound, surrender, and a deep connection to something far greater than ourselves. It left the heart full and the soul vibrating with joy and peace long after the session ended.

Shiv Yatra gently yet powerfully reminds you to slow down, to listen inward, and to accept yourself exactly as you are.

I walked away lighter, clearer, and deeply grateful, not just for the practices, but for the people, the energy, and the sincerity that infused every moment.

This experience stays with you, quietly transforming the way you see yourself and the world. Truly a blessing and something I will always hold close to my heart.

Kudos to Shiv sir and Harsh sir alongside your beautiful family for organising this for us! 🙏

Thank you to all the fellow participants too for all the superb memories! And most importantly Nikita, if not for her I would never have known of this beautiful opportunity, heartfelt thanks all. ❤️❤️🙏🙏

featured_reviews.name: Tanvi pandit
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience at Sacred Space has been truly wonderful.
Each session is well-structured, with every asana explained clearly along with the purpose and benefits behind it.
The atmosphere is calm and welcoming, making it easy to relax and focus. After each class, I feel both physically refreshed and mentally peaceful.
A truly enriching experience for overall well-being.
Highly recommended for anyone looking to improve both physically and mentally through yoga!

featured_reviews.name: Rushikesh Kalambe
featured_reviews.review_text: Namaste, Hari Om, it was a great spiritual journey with all yogis... Thank you Harsh sir n shiv sir for this wonderful Shiv Yatra! I feel so much better and calmer, I will always remember that Satvik Aahar.🕉️

featured_reviews.name: tejal ramteke
featured_reviews.review_text:
The yoga and pranayam classes here are a great experience. With small batch sizes, each student gets personal attention. Every pose is clearly demonstrated, and the instructors guide and correct you based on your ability. Shiv Sir and Harsh Sir are both kind, helpful, and encouraging. They explain the purpose and benefits of each asana, which adds meaning to the practice.

Even if the yoga session feels physically tiring, the post-yoga meditation is deeply calming. Harsh Sir often chants mantras or sings devotional songs during this time, creating a peaceful and spiritual atmosphere.

Overall, the experience brings noticeable changes in both body and mind, leaving you feeling refreshed, focused, and balanced.

featured_reviews.name: Vijay Kumbhoje
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Yoga House is a fantastic place to learn and practice yoga for improving one's health and wellbeing. The studio is located in a serene and peaceful environment that provides the perfect atmosphere for yoga practice. From the moment you step in, you are welcomed with warm hospitality and a sense of calm that instantly makes you feel at ease.

The instructors at The Yoga House are knowledgeable, skilled, and passionate about sharing the benefits of yoga with their students. They are well-trained in a variety of yoga styles and are adept at tailoring the practice to the individual needs of each student. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced practitioner, the instructors are committed to helping you achieve your health goals.

The classes are held in a spacious, well-lit studio with plenty of natural light and fresh air. The equipment and props are clean, well-maintained, and readily available, ensuring a comfortable and safe practice. The class sizes are small, which allows for more individual attention from the instructor, making it easier to learn and progress in your practice.

The Yoga House offers a range of classes, from gentle and restorative to more challenging and dynamic styles, all of which focus on improving flexibility, strength, and balance, as well as reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The variety of classes ensures that there is something for everyone, regardless of age or fitness level.

In conclusion, The Yoga House is an excellent place to learn and practice yoga for health benefits. The studio's welcoming atmosphere, skilled instructors, and well-equipped facilities make it a top choice for anyone looking to improve their physical and mental health through the practice of yoga. I highly recommend it to anyone who is interested in experiencing the transformative power of yoga.

featured_reviews.name: Penaz Mithuji
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been with TRF space for the last 6 months. I am one of those people who are not consistent with working out and challenging the body. What keeps me coming back each class (still, after 6 months) is the people, the instructors at TRF. Their knowledge and persistence push you give your best. They know your body more then you will. I blindly trust my coaches, each one of them. They have a holistic approach to dealing with the mind, and body. Highly recommend.

featured_reviews.name: toshee K
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been going to TRF space since over a year now and the experience has been nothing but amazing. All 4 of the trainers are enthusiastic, extremely competent and great people. While they have different specialties, one thing that holds them together is their passion for fitness and the drive to help others reach their goals. In the last year, they have not only transformed my body, but also my thinking by busting soo many fitness myths. TRF is not just a class for me now, it’s a way of life. I hope to continue at TRF forever because it’s the best place to reach your goals in the healthiest and most fun way!

featured_reviews.review_text: My first experience with TRF g been amazing I'm here since almost 2 years and I have got excellent results .
